content.short: CardanoBits is an early Cardano NFT collection of 10,000 time-locked collectible Cbits with secondary-market history.
content.description: CardanoBits is an early Cardano NFT collection that launched during the first wave of the ecosystem's collectible activity. The project minted 10,000 Cbits under a time-locked policy, giving the collection a fixed supply and a place in Cardano NFT history. After the initial sale, holders and collectors could only find pieces through secondary markets and community escrow channels. Its importance comes from being an early native-asset collection that helped test demand, wallets, and trading behavior before richer marketplace tooling matured.
